company.description: Cybersyn is a data-as-a-service (DaaS) company that offers businesses access to real-time data for informed decision-making. It specializes in consumer behavior analytics, enabling companies to understand spending patterns and market dynamics. By delivering standardized, ready-to-use data, Cybersyn helps organizations gain a competitive edge without the complexity of data management.
